# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 yuan-chao1, the Yuan's paper money (钞法). Generated by gen_yuan_chao.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 37; right after 21 y7, whose state
# of the month it reads); this line writes no monthly hook of its own. Order: start; end check; the Yuan's month (vanilla
# .41, the meter, the tier); January; at most one event.
oe_yc_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_init } } oe_yc_setup = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_m value = oe_yc_m_now }
        oe_yc_end_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on country_exists = c:CHI }
            c:CHI = { oe_yc_chi_month = yes }
            if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_yc_january = yes }
            oe_yc_events = yes
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Start (a 1337 game: the scheduler runs only there). Without the Mongol Yuan the line never opens (end 1).
oe_yc_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yc_init
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved } oe_yp_yuan_fallen = no }
        set_global_variable = oe_yc_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_trust value = 60 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_cred value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_tier value = 3 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_reform value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_print value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_need value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_wait value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_y value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n2 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_lapse2 value = 0 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_end value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yc: no standing Mongol Yuan (fallen, or not the Mongol dynasty), the line stays off (code 1)" }
}

# Any scope. End (design 3.1 "每月" item 1, 六.7): the Yuan fell -> 1; 1400.1.1 -> 3; 24 months after the suppression
# ended with code 2, 3 or 4 -> 2 (with code 1 the line runs on to 1400.1.1, for the restoration).
oe_yc_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { OR = { oe_y7_yuan_ok = no has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved oe_yp_yuan_fallen = yes } } oe_yc_close = { code = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yc: the line ends (code 1: the Yuan fell)" }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1400.1.1 } oe_yc_close = { code = 3 } debug_log = "oe_yc: the line ends (code 3: 1400.1.1)" }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_badm } OR = { global_var:oe_y7_end ?= 2 global_var:oe_y7_end ?= 3 global_var:oe_y7_end ?= 4 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_badm value = global_var:oe_yc_m }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_badm global_var:oe_yc_m >= oe_yc_bad_until } oe_yc_close = { code = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yc: the line ends (code 2: 24 months after the suppression failed)" }
    }
}
# Any scope (interface: F6's COLLAPSE_HOOKS, hook F6-H). The Yuan has fallen: the line ends with code 1.
oe_yc_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on } oe_yc_close = { code = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yc: the line ends (code 1: the Yuan fell)" }
}
# Any scope. Close the line with $code$: every modifier of the line comes off the Yuan.
oe_yc_close = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_end value = $code$ }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_on }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_due2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_due2 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { oe_yc_strip = yes } }
}
# CHI scope. Remove every modifier of the line.
oe_yc_strip = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_worn } remove_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_worn }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_broken } remove_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_broken }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_dead } remove_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_dead }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yc_in_kind } remove_country_modifier = oe_yc_in_kind }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yc_restore } remove_country_modifier = oe_yc_restore }
}

# CHI scope, monthly. Vanilla red_turban_rebellions.41 seen for the first time (a -10, b +5, once); the meter one point
# toward its target; the restoration phase's first month; the tier (its modifier when it changes, and each January).
oe_yc_chi_month = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_v41 } has_country_modifier = yua_hyperinflation }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_v41 value = 1 }
        oe_yc_move_trust = { amount = -10 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_v41 } has_country_modifier = yua_shortages }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_v41 value = 2 }
        oe_yc_move_trust = { amount = 5 }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_tgt value = oe_yc_target }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_trust < global_var:oe_yc_tgt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_trust add = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_trust > global_var:oe_yc_tgt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_trust add = -1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 3 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_p3m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_p3m value = global_var:oe_yc_m } }
    oe_yc_tier_step = yes
}
# CHI scope. The tier: on a change, or in January, the modifier of the tier (13 months, mode = replace; none at tier 3).
oe_yc_tier_step = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_tier_new value = oe_yc_tier_now }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { current_month = 1 NOT = { global_var:oe_yc_tier = global_var:oe_yc_tier_new } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_tier value = global_var:oe_yc_tier_new }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_yc_tier = 2 } has_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_worn } remove_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_worn }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_tier = 2 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yc_tier_worn months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_yc_tier = 1 } has_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_broken } remove_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_broken }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_tier = 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yc_tier_broken months = 13 mode = replace } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_yc_tier = 0 } has_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_dead } remove_country_modifier = oe_yc_tier_dead }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_tier = 0 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yc_tier_dead months = 13 mode = replace } }
    }
}
# Any scope. Change 钞信 by $amount$ (clamped 0-100), the record untouched (vanilla .41 is read by the target while it lasts).
oe_yc_move_trust = {
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_trust add = $amount$ }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_trust min = 0 max = 100 }
}
# Any scope (interface, design 4.4). Change 钞信 by $amount$ and the credit record the same (clamped -50..30), so the
# change lasts: the record keeps 85% each January. Light: options call it.
oe_yc_add_trust = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on }
        oe_yc_move_trust = { amount = $amount$ }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_cred add = $amount$ }
        clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_cred min = -50 max = 30 }
    }
}

# Any scope. The year's need (design 3.1 "每月" item 5): a suppression campaign is on (oe_y7_camp > 0), vanilla's
# river works are on the Yuan, gold below 3 months of income, Y4 .10 b (hook Y4-H1); at most 3.
oe_yc_calc_need = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n_war value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n_works value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n_gold value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n_c10 value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp global_var:oe_y7_camp > 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n_war value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_country_modifier = chi_yellow_river_works } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n_works value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { gold < oe_yc_g_3 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n_gold value = 1 } }
    # hook Y4-H1: Y4 .10 b (paid labourers) counts once, in the January after it.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_c10_used } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { var:oe_yv_c10 ?= 2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n_c10 value = 1 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_need value = global_var:oe_yc_n_war }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_need add = global_var:oe_yc_n_works }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_need add = global_var:oe_yc_n_gold }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_need add = global_var:oe_yc_n_c10 }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_need min = 0 max = 3 }
}
# Any scope, January. The record returns toward 0; the year's need; the tier's yearly price; .2 falls due (once .1 was
# decided, not in .1's year, not while vanilla's dynasty crisis is active).
oe_yc_january = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_cred value = oe_yc_cred_next }
    oe_yc_calc_need = yes
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_n_c10 = 1 } set_global_variable = oe_yc_c10_used }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yc_tier = 1 }
        oe_yp_change_loyalty = { unit = 3 amount = -2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yc_tier = 0 }
        oe_yp_change_loyalty = { unit = 3 amount = -3 }
        oe_yp_change_loyalty = { unit = 2 amount = -3 }
        if = { limit = { oe_y7_running = yes } oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = -3 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            global_var:oe_yc_reform >= 1
            global_var:oe_yc_y < oe_yc_year_now
            country_exists = c:CHI
            NOT = { c:CHI = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty } }
        }
        set_global_variable = oe_yc_due2
    }
}

# Any scope, monthly. Lapses, then at most one event: a due event first (.3, .4, .2), else .1's roll. While the Yuan already
# got an event this month a due event waits, at most 2 months (oe_yc_wait); .1's roll waits too.
oe_yc_events = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yc_late_1 = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_st_1 value = 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_reform value = 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_y value = oe_yc_year_now }
        oe_yc_add_trust = { amount = 5 }
        debug_log = "oe_yc: the debate on the paper money did not come in its window: the old notes are kept (reform 2)"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yc_due_2 = yes current_month > 3 }
        remove_global_variable = oe_yc_due2
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_y value = oe_yc_year_now }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_lapse2 add = 1 }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_pick value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yc_yuan_busy = yes global_var:oe_yc_wait < 2 }
        if = { limit = { oe_yc_due_any = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_wait add = 1 } }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { oe_yc_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_pick value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yc_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_pick value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yc_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_pick value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yc_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yc_chance_1 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_pick value = 1 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_pick = 1 } oe_yc_send_1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_pick = 2 } oe_yc_send_2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_pick = 3 } oe_yc_send_3 = yes }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_pick = 4 } oe_yc_send_4 = yes }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yc_pick > 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_wait value = 0 } }
}

# CHI scope. The numbers an event's text shows, stored on the Yuan before it is sent (r21: a value read when the text is
# shown must already be there; the test buttons run the same).
oe_yc_store = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_yc_t_trust value = global_var:oe_yc_trust }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yc_t_infl value = oe_yc_infl_pct }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yc_t_need value = global_var:oe_yc_need }
}
# Any scope. The sender of each event: its state, the shared guard (oe_yuan_ev_m), the numbers, the event to the Yuan.
oe_yc_send_1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_st_1 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_y value = oe_yc_year_now }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_last value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yc_m }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { oe_yc_store = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yc.1 } }
}
oe_yc_send_2 = {
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_n2 add = 1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_due2
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_y value = oe_yc_year_now }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_last value = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yc_m }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { oe_yc_store = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yc.2 } }
}
oe_yc_send_3 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_st_3 value = 1 }
    # (no year)
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_last value = 3 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yc_m }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { oe_yc_store = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yc.3 } }
}
oe_yc_send_4 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_st_4 value = 1 }
    # (no year)
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_last value = 4 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yc_m }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { oe_yc_store = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yc.4 } }
}

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# Any scope. Take the snapshot the readout .90 shows (inflation, target, flags of this moment).
oe_yc_snapshot = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_m value = oe_yc_m_now } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_s_flags value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        c:CHI = {
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_s_infl value = oe_yc_infl_pct }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_s_tgt value = oe_yc_target }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = yua_hyperinflation } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_s_flags add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = yua_shortages } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_s_flags add = 10 } }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = chi_yellow_river_works } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_s_flags add = 100 } }
            if = { limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_s_flags add = 1000 } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_yc_yuan_busy = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_s_flags add = 10000 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_s_flags add = 100000 } }
}
# Country scope (the current player). The readout .90.
oe_yc_test_status = { oe_yc_snapshot = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yc.90 }
# Any scope. Open the line now (today's date; a closed line is opened again).
oe_yc_test_start = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_end } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_end }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_init } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_init }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on } } oe_yc_setup = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_m value = oe_yc_m_now }
}
# Any scope. Run January's step now (whatever the month): the need, the tier's yearly price; .2 is sent at once when it
# falls due (the guard and the lapse are left out).
oe_yc_test_jan = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on country_exists = c:CHI }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_m value = oe_yc_m_now }
        oe_yc_january = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_yc_due_2 = yes } oe_yc_send_2 = yes }
    }
}
# Any scope. Set 钞信 to $v$ (the record stays: it drifts back toward the target one point a month) and apply the tier.
oe_yc_test_trust = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on country_exists = c:CHI }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_trust value = $v$ }
        c:CHI = { oe_yc_tier_step = yes }
    }
}
# Country scope (the current player, who must be the Yuan). Send an event to the current player through the same numbers
# as the sender (y7-sup3c's y73p* way: the old way sent it to an AI Yuan, where nobody could read it).
oe_yc_test_me_1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no has_global_variable = oe_yc_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_m value = oe_yc_m_now }
        # (no need)
        oe_yc_store = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yc.1
    }
}
oe_yc_test_me_2 = {

        limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no has_global_variable = oe_yc_on }

        oe_yc_calc_need = yes
        oe_yc_store = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yc.2
    }
}

    }
}
oe_yc_test_me_4 = {

}
# Any scope. Forget the line: every global and the modifiers and stored numbers on the Yuan; the line stays closed (end 9,
# test) until ycstart opens it again (the scheduler would otherwise start it anew the next month).
oe_yc_test_reset = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_on }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_m } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_trust } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_trust }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_cred } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_cred }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_tgt } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_tgt }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_tier } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_tier }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_tier_new } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_tier_new }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_reform } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_reform }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_print } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_print }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_need } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_need }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_n_war } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_n_war }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_n_works } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_n_works }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_n_gold } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_n_gold }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_n_c10 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_n_c10 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_c10_used } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_c10_used }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_due2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_due2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_n2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_n2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_lapse2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_lapse2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_y } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_y }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_wait } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_wait }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_pick } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_last } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_last }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_v41 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_v41 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_p3m } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_p3m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_badm } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_badm }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_y1n } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_y1n }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_s_infl } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_s_infl }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_s_tgt } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_s_tgt }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_s_flags } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_s_flags }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_st_1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_st_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_st_3 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_st_3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_st_4 } remove_global_variable = oe_yc_st_4 }
    set_global_variable = oe_yc_init
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yc_end value = 9 }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        c:CHI = {
            oe_yc_strip = yes
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yc_t_trust } remove_variable = oe_yc_t_trust }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yc_t_infl } remove_variable = oe_yc_t_infl }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yc_t_need } remove_variable = oe_yc_t_need }
        }
    }
}
